reason: This PR changes a planner rewrite in `logical_projection.go` for TopN pushdown with `expression.ScalarFunction`, which is directly optimizer-semantics and can affect result ordering/correctness across many queries. Even though the code delta is small, TopN/ByItem rewriting is a central logical-plan path with broad blast radius and wrong-plan risk, so it merits a focused deep review for Blocker/High issues.
